holy-land.name: The Holy Land
holy-land.dict: "O my people, enter the Holy Land which God has assigned for you" (5:21): Moses to the Children of Israel, who refuse for fear of its people and are left to wander forty years. Elsewhere it is "the land We blessed" (7:137, 21:71).

hunayn.name: Hunayn
hunayn.dict: "On the day of Hunayn, your great number impressed you, but it availed you nothing", and you turned back in retreat, until God sent down His serenity and troops you did not see (9:25-26). By tradition a valley near Mecca, where a battle was fought in 630.
